paper.title: The Impact of the Geometric Properties of the Constraint Set in Safe Optimization with Bandit Feedback

settings.name_in_paper: Safe optimization with bandit feedback (vector response y_t = Theta_* x_t + eps_t, known reward f, stage-wise safety constraint Theta_* x_t in E)
unmapped: Response is vector-valued: y_t = Theta_* x_t + eps_t with unknown full-rank Theta_* in R^{n x d}, n <= d
Reward f(Theta_* x) is an arbitrary known M-Lipschitz function of the expected response
Compact action set A in R^d with ||x||_2 <= L; rows of Theta_* have norm <= S
Safety: expected response must lie in a known arbitrary compact set E with nonempty interior every round
The learner knows the reward function f, the sets A and E, and a lower bound on the maximum shrinkage H_Y of the feasible response set (to choose T')
Initial conservative safe set G^0 has nonempty interior
settings.definition_quote: In each round $t \in [T]$, an agent chooses an action $x_t$ from the compact action set $\mathcal{A} \subset \mathbb{R}^d$ and then observes the noisy response $y_t := \Theta_* x_t + \epsilon_t$. ... the agent earns the reward $f(\Theta_* x_t)$, where the reward function $f:\mathbb{R}^n\rightarrow \mathbb{R}$ is known. The agent needs to ensure that ... the response $\Theta_* x_t$ lies within the known compact safety set $\mathcal{E}$

algorithms.name: Algorithm 1 (pure exploration on G^0 followed by optimistic safe exploration-exploitation)

bound.expression_latex: 2 M \sqrt{n} LS T' + M (T - T') \mathrm{Sharp}_{\mathcal{Y}}^{\infty} \left( \frac{2 \sqrt{2 \beta_T} L }{\sqrt{2 \nu + \lambda_- T'}} \right) + M \max (H_{\mathcal{Y}}^\infty,1) \sqrt{n 8 \beta_T (T - T') d \log \left( \frac{1 + T L^2}{d \nu} \right) }

symbols.n_resp: dimension n of the response vector
symbols.T_p: length T' of the pure exploration phase
symbols.Sharp_Y: infinity-norm sharpness of Y = Theta_* A ∩ E evaluated at 2 sqrt(2 beta_T) L / sqrt(2 nu + lambda_minus T')
symbols.beta_T: confidence radius squared: (sigma*sqrt(d*log((1+T L^2/nu)/(delta/n))) + sqrt(nu) S)^2
symbols.lambda_minus: min eigenvalue of E[x_t x_t^T] under the exploration sampling

conditions: Assumptions 1-4: ||x||_2 <= L on A, rows of Theta_* bounded by S; element-wise conditionally R-subgaussian noise; f is M-Lipschitz on E; G^0 has nonempty interior
tuning: exploration samples from G^0 with lambda_minus > 0

source.label: thm:main
source.quote: Let Assumptions ... hold. With probability at least $1 - 2 \delta$, we have that the regret of Algorithm \ref{alg:main_alg} is bounded as R_T \leq 2 M \sqrt{n} LS T' + M (T - T') \mathrm{Sharp}_{\mathcal{Y}}^{\infty} (...) + M \max (H_{\mathcal{Y}}^\infty,1) \sqrt{n 8 \beta_T (T - T') d \log ( \frac{1 + T L^2}{d \nu} ) } for any $T' \geq \max( t_{\delta}, t_h)$

results.notes: Probability 1-2delta. M mapped to L_lip, R to sigma, L to L_feat. Regret defined through noiseless rewards f(Theta_* x). Proof additionally assumes beta_T >= 1 (T large enough). Comparator is best safe action.

bound.expression_latex: 2 M \sqrt{n} LS T' + \frac{2 n \sqrt{2 \beta_T} \Gamma_{\mathcal{Y}} L M (T - T') }{\sqrt{2 \nu + \lambda_- T'}} + M \max (H_{\mathcal{Y}}^\infty,1) \sqrt{n 8 \beta_T (T - T') d \log( \frac{1 + T L^2}{d \nu})}

symbols.n_resp: dimension n of the response vector
symbols.Gamma_Y: polytope-sharpness constant of Y from Proposition 10

conditions: Y = Theta_* A ∩ E is polytope-sharp (e.g. convex)

source.label: cor:main
source.quote: If $\mathcal{Y}$ is polytope-sharp, then the regret of Algorithm~\ref{alg:main_alg} satisfies R_T \leq 2 M \sqrt{n} LS T' + \frac{2 n \sqrt{2 \beta_T} \Gamma_{\mathcal{Y}} L M (T - T') }{\sqrt{2 \nu + \lambda_- T'}} + ... with probability at least $1 - 2 \delta$ when $T' \geq \max( t_{\delta}, t_h)$.

source.label: cor:main
source.quote: In particular, choosing $T' = \max(T^{2/3},t_{\delta}, t_h)$ ensures that $R_T = \tilde{\mathcal{O}} \left(T^{2/3} \right)$.

results.notes: Hides dependence on d, n, M, L, S, Gamma_Y, H_Y, lambda_minus. Holds w.p. 1-2delta.
